## What I did

`configTOCsfFactories` had no early return for already transformed code

THe failing test was for

```ts
import { defineMain } from '@storybook/react-vite/node';

export default defineMain({});
````

the test title state that there's nothing to change but the issue is that `dedent` applies \n to the code, then `transform` applies `recast` uppon the code which apply platform line break. on windows it would be `\r\n` . Then the test would break

human_comments.body:
For `configType === 'main'`, `loadConfig().parse()` does not populate `_exportsObject` from `defineMain(...)` calls (only `definePreview` is parsed), so if a file is already `export default defineMain(...)` *and* has named exports, this function will proceed and later hit the `hasNamedExports` branch, pushing a second `export default` while leaving the existing one. Please handle `isAlreadyTransformed && hasNamedExports` to avoid generating invalid modules (e.g. merge into the existing `defineMain` call when its argument is an object expression, or skip with no-op).
```suggestion
  if ((configType === 'main' && isAlreadyTransformed) || (configType === 'preview' && isAlreadyTransformed && !hasNamedExports)) {
```

**Early-return can skip required import fixups**

At Line 45, returning early before Lines 199-230 bypasses import normalization. A file like `export default defineMain({})` (without a valid `defineMain` import from the expected framework package) is now treated as “already transformed” and never repaired.
